name: account_status
description: Workspace, calling key (id, name, env test/live, scopes), live_enabled, kill_switch, pending_approvals count. Call first.

name: sender_list
description: The From addresses you can pick: address, display_name, transport (where a send from it goes), is_default, status ready|needs_domain|transport_missing. Read-only; a human adds addresses and transports. Use an address as email_send `from`.

name: email_send
description: Send (queue) one email. `from` is one of sender_list's addresses (or an address on a verified domain); the transport is chosen by `from` unless you pass transport_id. Result status is queued or pending_approval (poll approval_get with approval_id, never decide); a blocked policy is an error with code blocked_by_policy. Test keys sandbox mail; use delivered@test.mailcraft.local. Use dry_run to render and lint without sending. Pass idempotency_key to make retries safe.

transport_id.description: force this transport (UUID from sender_list); omit to route by `from`

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: email_get
description: Get one email: status, from_addr, to_addr, subject, attempts, last_error, policy_decisions. Timeline is in email_events.

name: email_events
description: Event timeline of one email (type, enhanced_code, diagnostic, occurred_at).

name: email_cancel
description: Cancel a queued, deferred or pending_approval email.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: email_list
description: List emails, newest first. Filters: status, stream, env, q (case-insensitive substring of to/from/subject, or an exact email id), from/to (created_at bounds: YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339).

name: broadcast_send
description: Send ONE template to a list of recipients (up to 5000): each row becomes a queued email and contacts are upserted. A live key mails real people; test keys sandbox it. ALWAYS run it first with dry_run:true and read data.skipped[] (reason per dropped row: invalid_email, duplicate, invalid_data, suppressed, unsubscribed, not_allowed, missing_variable) and data.schedule (pacing under the daily cap), and check the rendering with broadcast_preview. Result status is queued or pending_approval (one approval_id for the whole broadcast: poll approval_get, never decide). Pass idempotency_key so a retry cannot send twice. Per-recipient template variables: first_name, last_name, email, data.<column>.

from.description: one of sender_list's addresses, or an address on a verified domain

transport_id.description: force this transport (UUID from sender_list); omit to route by `from`

subject.description: replaces the template subject; may use the same variables

max_per_day.description: upper bound on sends per day; the lowest of this and the transport/key caps applies

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: broadcast_preview
description: Render the template for ONE recipient exactly as broadcast_send would send it (subject, html, text). Nothing is stored or sent.

name: broadcast_list
description: List broadcasts, newest first, with status (pending_approval|sending|done) and per-status counts.

name: broadcast_get
description: One broadcast with counts, skipped rows and its recipients' email status, paginated by email id (next_cursor). Filter recipients with status.

status.description: only recipients with this email status

name: domain_add
description: Add a sending domain; returns the DNS records the human must publish. A domain with relay_sender set sends that mailbox address through the default relay and needs no records.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: domain_check
description: Re-check DNS for a domain (verify). Returns the domain with status not_started|pending|verified|failed, last_checked_at and per-record status; a record that is not verified has detail (why) and, when DNS returned something else, found (what it returned).

name: template_create
description: Create a template with a draft v1 (give html, mjml, or content + format). alias defaults to a slug of name. Publish it before sending.

content.description: string, or an object for format json

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: template_get
description: Get a template by id or alias: newest version with source_format + source (the html/mjml as authored, else the block tree as JSON), subject, preheader and the canonical tree in template.

name: template_list
description: List templates.

name: template_update
description: Rename, change alias or stream, and/or add a new draft version (give html, mjml, or content + format; subject/preheader for html and mjml, empty preheader clears). Nothing goes live until template_publish. Changing alias breaks sends and automations that name the old one (409 template_exists when taken).

content.description: string, or an object for format json

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: template_publish
description: Publish the newest template draft, or the given version, so sends use it.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: template_preview
description: Render a template with variables; returns subject, html, text, lint[], the variables the content reads and warnings. Renders the saved version (default newest), or unsaved html/mjml/content (+format, subject, preheader) without storing it. Undefined variable is 422 template_render_failed. Sends nothing.

content.description: string, or an object for format json

name: template_import
description: Import a template from html, mjml or json.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: template_export
description: Export a template as html, mjml or json.

name: template_versions
description: Version history of a template, newest first: version, source_format, created_at, published_at, published (true for the live one).

name: template_version_get
description: One template version with its source and block tree.

name: template_restore
description: Copy an older version into a NEW draft; history is kept. Publish the new draft with template_publish to make it live.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: template_discard_draft
description: Discard unpublished changes: deletes the never-published versions newer than the published one. Cannot be undone. 409 no_draft or no_published_version when there is nothing to discard. Destructive.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: content_lint
description: Lint subject/html for deliverability and compliance issues. Sends nothing.

name: contact_upsert
description: Create or update a contact by email.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: contact_get
description: Get a contact by id or email.

name: contact_list
description: List contacts. q is a case-insensitive substring of email, first or last name. Each item carries suppressed and suppression_reason.

name: contact_update
description: Edit a contact by id or email. Omitted fields stay; an empty string clears first_name, last_name or timezone; properties merge shallowly and a null value deletes that key.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: contact_activity
description: Recent activity of one contact (newest first, at most 25 each): events, emails, automation runs, topic opt-in state and segments.

name: contact_import
description: Upsert up to 5000 contacts in one call (same as contact_upsert per row). A bad row (invalid email or timezone) is skipped and listed in data.failed with its zero-based index; the rest are imported. Pass idempotency_key so a retry does not repeat it.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: contact_delete
description: Permanently delete a contact. Destructive.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: segment_create
description: Create a segment: a rule-tree filter ({and:[..]}, {or:[..]}, {not:..} or {field, op, value}) or, with no filter, a manual list. Check a filter with segment_preview first.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: segment_list
description: List segments with member_count (who matches right now for a filter segment).

name: segment_preview
description: Who a filter matches right now: {count, sample} (5 newest). Ops: eq neq lt lte gt gte in contains exists. Fields: email, first_name, last_name, timezone, created_at, properties.<key>, topic:<key>, event_count:<event>, days_since:<event>. Stores nothing.

name: segment_update
description: Replace a segment's name and filter (full replace; omit filter to make it a manual list). Overwrites the previous rule. 409 when another segment has the name.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: segment_delete
description: Delete a segment. 409 invalid_state while an automation still names it in a trigger or add_to_segment step. Destructive.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: segment_add_members
description: Add contacts (by email, up to 1000) to a segment.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: event_names
description: Event names tracked in the last 90 days with counts and last_seen_at, newest first (use them as automation triggers).

name: event_send
description: Track an event for a contact (upserts the contact). May trigger automations. dry_run lists would_send[] without persisting.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: automation_create
description: Create an automation (trigger, steps, approval policy, caps). First sends need human approval per its approval setting.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: automation_get
description: Get an automation.

name: automation_list
description: List automations. Archived ones are hidden unless status is archived.

name: automation_pause
description: Pause an automation.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: automation_resume
description: Resume a paused automation.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: automation_archive
description: Archive a draft or paused automation (409 invalid_state otherwise). It leaves the default list and never runs; automation_unarchive brings it back.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: automation_unarchive
description: Bring an archived automation back as a draft (publish it to go live).

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: automation_test
description: Start a REAL run of an automation for ONE contact now, whatever its status, skipping the entry rule (contact is created if new). A test key keeps every email in the sandbox; a live key sends for real once the workspace is live (kill switch, suppressions, topic opt-outs and the approval policy still apply). Poll automation_run_get with data.run_id. There is no dry run: use a test key unless a human said otherwise.

properties.description: properties of the simulated trigger event

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: automation_run_get
description: One automation run with its step log: state, current_step, next_wake_at, exit_reason, test and steps[{step_key, result, at}] (why an email was held, a wait timed out, the run exited).

name: automation_simulate
description: Simulate an automation against a sample event; nothing is sent or persisted.

name: automation_runs
description: List runs of an automation, newest first (each has contact_email, exit_reason and test).

name: approval_list
description: List approval items (humans decide them, you cannot).

name: approval_get
description: Get an approval item (payload.preview has the subject/text/html; reason is the decider's note); poll this after a pending_approval result.

name: settings_get_instructions
description: Read workspace settings; `custom_instructions` is the workspace's writing guidance for LLM emails (null when unset).

name: settings_set_instructions
description: ADMIN KEY ONLY (agent keys get 403 forbidden_scope). Replace the workspace's writing instructions for LLM emails (max 2,000 chars, trimmed; empty string clears). Overwrites the previous text. Style and tone only: cannot override safety rules (no invented features, template-owned links, unsubscribe always included). Too long is 422 custom_instructions_too_long.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: kill_switch_status
description: Whether the workspace kill switch is on (`on`) and which keys are individually paused (`paused_keys`).

name: kill_switch_engage
description: Emergency stop: halt all sending, or only one key when key_id is given. Only a human (admin) can turn it off again.

key_id.description: pause just this key (UUID); omit for the whole workspace

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: doctor
description: Server-side health and deliverability checks with hints.

name: audit_list
description: Audit log of actions taken with API keys.

before.description: return rows with id below this (the next_cursor)

name: go_live_request
description: Ask a human to enable live sending. Creates a go_live approval; poll approval_get. You cannot approve it.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: policy_propose
description: Propose a send-policy change for a key ({send: auto|needs_approval|blocked}); a human approves it.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request returns the original result

name: policy_get
description: Current send policy (what is auto, needs_approval, blocked).
